flash_693654.description: We ask Hashem for the blessing of being able to be clever, so that we can use our wisdom to cope well in this world.

flash_693653.description:

The Directorate recommends not clicking the link and instead checking the reservation directly through the official website or app.

flash_693655.description: Bipartisan US senators urge the Trump administration to release classified details of proposed Saudi nuclear deal, including two “side letters."

flash_693673.description: Those 600 trucks of aid that enter the Gaza Strip each day should go to the Druze, not to Hamas. Opinion.

flash_693698.description:

According to Galei Tzahal, the event was not approved by the relevant IDF authorities, did not follow the standard chain of authorization and violated military directives.

The IDF stated that “the incident will be investigated and the procedures will be clarified."

flash_693694.description:
Following the sirens that sounded a short while ago regarding a hostile aircraft infiltration in the areas of Manara and Margaliot, an interceptor was launched toward a suspicious target.

An initial assessment indicates that it was most likely a false target. The incident is still under review.

Missile and rocket alerts were activated due to the interception attempts.

flash_693692.description: Rabbinical group heads to court after Tel Aviv-Jaffa municipality bars physical separation between men and women at planned Tel Baruch Beach prayer service.

flash_693690.description: Sirens warn of hostile aircraft infiltration in Manara and Margaliot, northern Israel

flash_693687.description: IDF eliminates two terrorists plotting new attacks and rebuilding Hamas capabilities; one of them had infiltrated Erez Crossing on October 7.

flash_693711.description:
i24NEWS correspondent Mordechai Wagenheim reported, citing a "reliable source," that US Vice President JD Vance is planning to host a Shabbat dinner this week.

According to the report, the dinner, which follows a meeting with prominent Jewish conservative radio host Sid Rosenberg, is part of a broader effort to mend ties with the Jewish community.

The report further stated that the guest list has been extensively scaled down from its original 40 people, in an attempt to keep conversations from leaking.

flash_693709.description: An undercover police operation in Jerusalem led to three arrests, with suspected cocaine, pills, cash and mobile phones seized during the bust.

flash_693757.description: An artistic interpretation of the annual Jewish Holidays.
